title: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
abstract: arXiv:2611.22050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. translated_title: DSADiff：通过缓解复杂性与不平衡引起的偏差、实现数据结构感知的晶体结构预测扩散模型
translated_abstract: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是加速新材料生成与发现的重要步骤。近年来，基于扩散模型的晶体结构预测方法取得了显著进展。然而，面对多样化的材料空间时，现有模型仍然存在生成偏差问题，而用于追踪此类性能差异来源的系统性方法仍然有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LAS（分层分析策略），这是一个机制分析框架，它识别出晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡是影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并进一步揭示了它们与模型生成性能之间的关系。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出了DSADiff（数据结构感知扩散模型），这是一种数据结构感知的扩散模型，它将LAS识别出的关键因素转化为统一的生成难度表示，并利用该表示来共同驱动特征……
tldr: 该论文提出了LAS机制分析框架，识别出晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡是影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并据此提出数据结构感知扩散模型DSADiff，通过统一的生成难度表示来缓解生成偏差，从而提升晶体结构预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LAS, a mechanism analysis framework identifying crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as key factors affecting generation difficulty, and introduces DSADiff, a data structure-aware diffusion model that mitigates generation biases through a unified generation difficulty representation to improve crystal structure prediction.
